mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 6-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), a federal funds rate increase above 4.5% triggers hawkish policy that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising home construction, boosting corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) indicate dual stress on manufacturing and labor markets, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.0% annualized), a retail sales decline below 370,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
